result.summary: The disk I/O errors were Windows file-lock contention on the shared SQLite files, not corruption or disk-full: both tiers pass quick_check and the volume has ~235 GB free. PERSIST journal mode removes the per-commit journal delete/recreate step where the contention surfaced, bounded retries absorb residual transient errors on write connect/commit and hot attach, and the read-only hot attach stops readers from competing for write locks at all. The 2026-07-03 failed write turned out to cost breadth, not the session edge: 2026-07-03 was the observed Independence Day holiday, so the true edge is 2026-07-02, which the hot tier held for only 60 tickers until the post-repair broad refresh restored it for 1,322.
